title: Word frequencies merged from a fixed number of goroutines
task: Count word frequencies across many documents in package `wordfreq`: `Count(docs []string, workers int) map[string]int`, words lowercased and split on whitespace. Use exactly `workers` goroutines and merge their results; the answer must equal the single-goroutine count and be stable under `-race`. Share as little as you can between the goroutines.
